title: WebGPU Alpha-to-Coverage in Rust: 4x MSAA Foliage
description: Learn WebGPU alpha-to-coverage with Rust and wgpu by rendering 25 instanced oak trees with 4x MSAA, alpha-textured leaves, depth testing, and hardware resolve.
imageAlt: Dense grove of alpha-textured oak trees rendered with 4x WebGPU MSAA and alpha-to-coverage against a dark blue background.
